findings: INSTRUMENT: scratchpad/vol.mjs measures, per clip, peak tip speed (active + all frames), forward reach, MIN-CONTACT (smallest forward offset at which the swept weapon hull touches a stationary target column y0.15-1.75 r0.17), and the grip hand world z. This is the number three rounds never measured.

ROOT CAUSE A (the blade): every attack clip keeps the grip hand 0.63-1.35 m in front of its own root through the whole ACTIVE window, and the weapon capsule starts socket_a_dist past the hand. MIN-CONTACT is 0.50-2.71 m for player classes and 0.83-1.50 m for enemies. The blade physically cannot occupy the 0-0.5 m band in front of the attacker at any point the hitbox is live.

ROOT CAUSE A mechanism: anim-author.mjs solves swing_scale against RI-CMB04 B peak tip speed by SHRINKING the excursion about an aim pose that is arm-forward (upperarm_r.rx aim -71 deg for chop_overhead). A shrunken arc about a forward-pointing shoulder is a blade parked out front for the whole swing. The follow pose (arm down, hand at the belly) sits at phase 2.3 - AFTER the hitbox closes at phase 2.0.

ROOT CAUSE B (the lunge): separation pushes the target at a hard cap of 0.05 m/frame while a champion chop carries its root 0.8 m in 10 active frames (0.08 m/frame). The lunge outruns the push, so a target that started at 0.35 m ends up ~0.3 m inside the attacker where nothing can reach it. This is also why the separation model measures as consuming nothing.

TWO CLIP SYNTHESIS PATHS: (1) clips.json archetypes, hand-authored by tools/harness/anim-author.mjs, used by enemy attacks and by game/data/combat/spine/*.json player baselines; (2) game/src/combat/swing.js buildSwing() from game/data/weapons/clip-registry.json profiles, used by W1-10s 87-weapon roster slots (clip_garrison_r1_3 etc). The r3 peak-tip-speed regression (39.6-45.2 m/s) is in path (2), which no solver constrains and which cmb-probe never samples.

Champion weapon socket_a_dist_m is 0.45 (a 45 cm dead haft between the hand and the start of the hitbox); player straight sword is 0.11. Both still fail min-contact, so socket_a is a contributor and not the cause.

Peak tip speed in the spine clips is now UNDER declared everywhere (18.08/18.5 worst ratio) — the 39.6-45.2 m/s regression is in the swing.js/clip-registry path, not here.

TIP SPEED, ALL CLIPS (tools/harness/cmb-tipspeed.mjs, NEW): the game can play 2,713 clips (24 from clips.json archetypes, 2,689 from swing.js/clip-registry). BEFORE this round 1,310 exceeded their declared column, peak 158.13 m/s. Every one of the twenty worst peaked in the STARTUP or the RECOVERY, not the active window: dgr_reed_dirk 2h.run.r1 moved its tip 1.10 m in ONE frame on animation frame 3.

TIP SPEED ROOT CAUSE: a swing profile is authored in PHASE space and RI-CMB04 B's column constrains FRAME space. Nothing joined them, so the same profile at a 6-frame startup ran 4x faster than at a 24-frame startup, and every contextual multiplier that shortens a startup (running x0.70, rolling x0.60, chain hit-2 x0.78) multiplied the windup's tip speed by its reciprocal. FIX: swing.js calibrateExcursion() damps anticipation and follow-through to fit the frames they have and leaves the ACTIVE band alone (that band carries the declared arc_sweep_deg that _yawGain already solved to).

TIP SPEED RESIDUAL — CROSS-PIECE, W1-10's data: after the fix every remaining peak is INSIDE the active window and is arithmetic on W1-10's own declarations. gsw_hist_greatblade 2h.r1.1 declares arc_sweep_deg 271.4 over 18 active frames with a solved socket_b of 3.115 m; hlb_reed_partisan 2h.roll.r2 declares 359.9 deg over 19 frames. A 3 m blade sweeping 271 deg in 0.3 s IS 82 m/s and no animation can make it otherwise. RI-CMB04 B declares greatsword capsule_length_m 1.35; the roster's solved capsule is 3.115. Owed to RI-WPN02/RI-WPN03.
